summary: Iteration 2 of BookLoop (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). All new features validated end-to-end. Backend: 43/43 pytest tests pass (added 10 new tests covering /api/books/search + /api/books/isbn (OpenLibrary proxy, auth required, minimum-query short-circuit, unknown-ISBN fallback), chat image messages via /api/swaps/{id}/messages (image_url stored + surfaced in GET, empty payload rejected 400), and self-contained users/{id} reviews payload assertion — plus every previous test still green: full 2-user swap lifecycle, discover, map clusters, books CRUD, upload+/api/files, notifications, auth). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login → all screens verified. Add Book FAB opens; mode-search/mode-scan/mode-manual segmented control renders; typing 'atomic habits' returns 20 search-result rows via /api/books/search; tapping a result switches to Manual and prefills title/author/cover (screenshot confirms 'Atomic Habits' by 'James Clear' with OL cover). Scan pane renders with open-scanner button (barcode camera cannot be automated, per request). Map tab renders real Leaflet iframe over OpenStreetMap tiles with sage neighborhood count markers (14, 2, 1, 1, 0) and the metric card '20 readers nearby · 28 books · tap a cluster'. Profile tab shows share-invite + copy-invite controls. Discover → person profile shows tappable reviews-summary that navigates to /reviews/{user_id} (Reviews screen with rating + count + swaps + empty-state fallback). Placeholder BookCover renders for books without cover_url. No red screens, no console errors, no Metro disconnect this run.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: expose a testID on the Sign in submit button in app/(auth)/login.tsx (current tests fall back to get_by_text which is brittle if copy changes).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/books/search and /api/books/isbn are correctly auth-gated via Depends(get_current_user) and use httpx.AsyncClient with a 12s timeout + User-Agent header to avoid the previous Google Books 429 rate-limit; failure paths return {results:[]} / a stub result rather than raising — good UX.
POST /api/swaps/{id}/messages accepts {image_url} and sets type='image'; validation correctly rejects when both text is empty and image_url is missing (400).
GET /api/users/{id} returns reviews[] with rater_name/rater_avatar populated; reviews screen at app/reviews/[id].tsx handles the empty state gracefully.

add.tsx segmented control uses testID=mode-{search|scan|manual} matching the review spec; search results are debounced (450ms) and rendered via FlatList with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' — solid UX.
DensityMap.web.tsx uses an iframe that loads Leaflet from unpkg CDN — verified iframe renders OSM tiles and cluster markers on web.
BookCover (src/components/ui.tsx) generates deterministic colored placeholders with the title initial when uri is missing — no broken image icon observed in Discover feed.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_bookloop_api.py (added TestBookSearch, TestChatImage, TestUserReviews classes; converted reviews test to self-contained mini-swap to avoid xdist worker fixture-isolation flake)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all targeted flows passed on this run)

seed_data_creation: Backend continues to seed 8 Messina demo users + ~22 books idempotently on startup. Tests create additional TEST_-prefixed users/books/swaps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both the OpenLibrary proxy and the Leaflet iframe map depend on outbound network (openlibrary.org, unpkg.com, tile.openstreetmap.org). If those become unreachable in the preview sandbox, book-search will fall back to []; the map iframe will render an empty tile grid. Login submit button has no testID — use page.get_by_text('Sign in', exact=True) as a fallback. Metro hot-reload can occasionally disconnect mid-run (documented iter 1); if the WS message 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' fires, page.reload() recovers cleanly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
